title.en: Chapter 15 — The Court and the Bail

book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.en: The judge was a fat man, in a wig.
And before him, three priests from Bombay.
And the judge said: Passepartout.

sentences.ar: متهم بدخول معبد بجزمته، وضرب كهنة.
sentences.en: Accused of entering a temple with his shoes on, and striking priests.
And Passepartout cried: Bombay?
I thought it was the temple in the forest!
And the judge said: what forest?

sentences.ar: وفوغ حط إيده على كتف باسبارتو، وقال: اسكت.
sentences.en: And Fogg put his hand on Passepartout's shoulder, and said: be quiet.
The judge said: do you confess?
Passepartout said: I confess.

sentences.ar: قال القاضي: خمستعشر يوم سجن، وتلاتمية جنيه غرامة.
sentences.en: The judge said: fifteen days in prison, and three hundred pounds fine.

sentences.ar: والسيد، لأنه مسؤول عن خادمه: تمان أيام سجن، ومية وخمسين.
sentences.en: And the master, being responsible for his servant: eight days in prison, and a hundred and fifty.
And Fix, in the corner, rubbed his hands.
Eight days.
More than enough.
And Fogg said: I ask for bail.
The judge said: bail?
A thousand pounds each.
Fogg said: fine.

sentences.ar: وطلع من الكيس ألفين جنيه، وحطهم عالطاولة.
sentences.en: And took two thousand pounds from the bag, and put them on the table.
And the judge looked at him.
And Fix's face went green.
And the judge said: fine.
Free until the trial.
And Fogg said: come, Passepartout.
And they went out, and ran to the harbour.
And Passepartout saying: two thousand pounds!
Because of me!
Because of my shoes!

sentences.ar: وقال فوغ: بنرجعهم إذا رجعنا للمحاكمة.
sentences.en: And Fogg said: we get them back if we return for the trial.
Passepartout said: and do we return?
Fogg said: no.
And the steamer Rangoon was in the harbour, and it was eleven.
And the three boarded.

sentences.ar: وفيكس ركب وراهم، وهو بيعض شفافه.
sentences.en: And Fix boarded after them, biting his lip.
